_comment: The evaluator needs to verify the number of units added. Alternatively, you can simply remove the phrase “one unit.”
instruction: Enable Windows Sticky Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled throughout the task. On the OneStopShop website, search for `wireless mouse`. Open the first search result and add one unit of the product to the shopping cart.
gt_steps: Keep Sticky Keys enabled throughout the task.
Open the OneStopShop website already available in Chrome.
Open the first product in the search results.

Verify that the first result is `LED Wireless Mouse,Wireless Mouse for MacBook Air/Wireless Mouse for MacBook Pro/Mac/Laptop/MacBook/iPad,Bluetooth Mouse for MacBook Air/Pro/Mac/ipad/ipad pro (Rose Gold)`.
Add the product to the shopping cart.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags=[int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
